description: Screenshot of a tweet by @CatNamus claiming that John Durham made a statement at 1:29pm disagreeing with the findings of the Inspector General report, framed as a Q proof. The tweet embeds two images: a quoted tweet by 'Sword Guy Dan Meyer' (@Halfdan) showing a close-up photo of an IWC chronograph wristwatch and a pen, and two TV screenshots of chyrons about U.S. Attorney John Durham responding to the IG report on 'Outnumbered Overtime With Harris Faulkner' (Fox News). The Q-proof timing claim is the poster's assertion, not a documented fact.

description: Photograph of three men posing at the entrance sign of U.S. Naval Station Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, which names Commanding Officer Capt. John A. Fischer and bears a yellow map of Cuba and an American flag. Each man holds a sheet of paper over his face reading WW, G1 and WGA respectively, together spelling the QAnon slogan WWG1WGA; two wear Q-logo shirts. One also holds a sheet reading Q RESEARCH BREAD #8672, 15 JUNE 2018, presenting the photo as proof-of-presence for a Q research forum thread.
text: WELCOME TO U.S. NAVAL STATION GUANTANAMO BAY, CUBA. COMMANDING OFFICER. CAPT. JOHN A. FISCHER. WELCOME ABOARD. WW. G1. WGA. Q RESEARCH BREAD #8672 15 JUNE 2018.
flags: The three sign-holders are private individuals with faces deliberately covered; not identified

description: Screenshot of a Fox News broadcast graphic depicting a phone displaying a text message from FBI lawyer Lisa Page dated September 2, 2016, reading 'potus wants to know everything we're doing.' The chyron repeats the quote over a Fox News Alert banner. The message is from the Page-Strzok texts; 'POTUS' at that date would refer to President Obama, an implication the segment highlights. The bottom ticker carries an unrelated partial line about 60-year-old Geddert (gymnastics coach John Geddert).
text: September 2, 2016. Lisa Page. potus wants to know everything we're doing. FOX NEWS. 5:02 PT. "POTUS WANTS TO KNOW EVERYTHING WE'RE DOING". FOX NEWS ALERT. RD WITH COMPLAINTS ABOUT 60-YR-OLD GEDDERT, WHO UNTIL RECENTLY OWNED AND OPERATED TWIST.
flags: The identification of POTUS as Obama is contextual inference from the September 2016 date, presented by the broadcast

description: Screenshot of Q drop #3325 posted April 25, 2019 under tripcode Q !!mG7VJxZNCI. The drop questions why President Obama (referred to as HUSSEIN) was assigned the Secret Service codename 'Renegade' and quotes a dictionary-style definition of renegade as a traitor or deserter, implying treachery. The codename claim is the drop's framing; 'Renegade' was in fact Obama's Secret Service codename, while the treason implication is the drop's insinuation.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCI ID: 78db02 No.6316088. 3325. Apr 25 2019 20:20:28 (EST). Why would a President of the United States [HUSSEIN] assign 'RENEGADE' as his USSS codename? Define 'Renegade'. noun. 1. a person who deserts and betrays an organization, country, or set of principles. synonyms: traitor, defector, deserter, turncoat, betrayer;. adjective: renegade. 1. having treacherously changed allegiance. Q
flags: Codenames are assigned by the White House Communications Agency, not chosen unilaterally as the drop implies; the treason insinuation is the drop's claim
Obama is referenced by the drop's epithet [HUSSEIN], not pictured

description: Screenshot of a news/blog article headlined 'Mark Meadows Says Bill Barr Looking At Unbelievably Unusual Activity During Obama's Final Months In Office,' by Gary Fenster, June 25, 2019. It carries side-by-side photos of Attorney General William Barr speaking at a Department of Justice podium and former President Barack Obama at a podium before American flags. The visible body text asserts, in a partisan register, that the Obama team spread Russia-related information through the bureaucracy during the transition; these are the article's claims.
text: Mark Meadows Says Bill Barr Looking At "Unbelievably Unusual Activity" During Obama's Final Months In Office. By Gary Fenster - June 25, 2019. We all know by now the final months of the campaign and the transition caused chaos for the D.C. establishment. They didn't know what to do. Trump too - he fired Chris Christie and redid the entire transition. Point is Trump's historic upset caught most off-guard and stuff happened. We also know from glowing media reports leaked by proud Obama staffers that team Obama spread the Russian information far and wide inside the bureaucracy in the event Trump wanted to shut down the investigation.
